titulo: Coca-Cola (Aug 2020): $7.04 billion in dividends paid, 4,000 employees will first be. Now the math.
caption:
From the archive: Aug 2020. Not today's news.
Coca-Cola, Aug 28, 2020 (James Quincey, press release): "We have been on a multi-year journey to transform our organization"
Coca-Cola's August 28, 2020 8-K says the first voluntary separation offers will go to about 4,000 employees in the US, Canada and Puerto Rico. Its 2020 10-K reports $7,047 million in dividends paid.

Same year: $7.04 billion in dividends paid, 2020, company-wide. $7,047 million of dividends paid during 2020, company-wide (Form 10-K).
The math: $7.04 billion in dividends paid, 2020, company-wide ÷ 4,000 employees = $1.76 million in dividends per employee offered a buyout. The result is approximate.
The facts: $7.04 billion in dividends paid, 2020, company-wide (SEC EDGAR · Coca-Cola, Feb 25, 2021). 4,000 employees will first be offered (SEC EDGAR · Coca-Cola, Aug 28, 2020). Two numbers from two SEC filings, side by side. The 4,000 are the first employees offered voluntary separation, not layoffs. The $7,047 million is dividends paid during 2020, company-wide, per the 10-K.

Multi-year journey. Here is the column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Coca-Cola, Aug 28, 2020; SEC EDGAR · Coca-Cola, Feb 25, 2021.

Swipe: the sentence, the number, the math, our take.
